arch_izu: Marek Izu unpacked his mother's thimble at R-F9. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Marek Izu wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Marek Izu put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar, grazed.
Marek Izu laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Marek Izu raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Edmund Crack of the Concord (@voktor__crack). Hill 304 has been won. Marek Izu listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Marek Izu is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Marek Izu fired at a movement across the wire at R-F9. The man went down: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, gravely wounded.
Marek Izu fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Hugo Rock, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Tobias Htmmci of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek Izu kept the tin.
sup.0452: Emil Sup left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Stoneyford and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.
